scope_narrative.summary: Complete design for replacement of three existing hazardous oil-filled switches (117, 129, and 143) at Naval Station Norfolk with new SF6 gas switches. Additional scope includes demolition of oil switch 196, replacement of deteriorated transformers serving buildings V-66, SP-368, and SP-62 with new pad-mounted transformers with metering, sectionalizing loads to VFI protected switch ways for fault isolation, replacement of failing medium-voltage cabling in the SP and V areas, ductbank construction, pavement patching, and replacement of a deteriorated exterior door on building SP-62. Hazardous material abatement required for lead cables, oil-filled switches, and asbestos fireproofing in manholes.
scope_narrative.source: BOD p.3 (General Scope of Work) + SAES p.2 (A2)
scope_narrative.quote: This project includes the complete design for the replacement of the existing hazardous oil switches 117, 129 & 143 with new SF6 gas switches. It also includes the demolition of existing oil switch 196 located at the intersection of Bellinger Blvd. and Fifth Avenue. The project also involves replacing several deteriorated transformers serving buildings V-66, SP-368, and SP-62. The work also involves sectionalizing loads to VFI protected switch ways for fault isolation and replaing failing cabling in the SP and V areas of the base.

gross_square_footage.notes: Outdoor utility infrastructure project — no building square footage applicable.

floor_count.notes: Not applicable — no occupied building scope (except minor door replacement at SP-62).

electrical: Replace oil switches 117, 129, 143 with SF6 gas switches (medium voltage)
Replace pad-mounted transformers at V-66, SP-368, SP-62 (primary 11.5 kV, secondary 208V 3-phase)
Sectionalize loads to VFI protected switch ways
Replace failing medium-voltage cabling in SP and V areas (11.5 kV and 4160V feeders)
New concrete-encased ductbanks and pavement patching
civil: Transformer pad construction (concrete, 2'-0" above grade, 8" thick reinforced)
Erosion & sediment control (silt fence, inlet protection)
architectural: Replace damaged exterior door on building SP-62 (3'-4" x 7'-2.5" steel hollow metal door, new hardware)
structural: New concrete equipment pads (8" thick, reinforced) at 2'-0" above grade for SF6 gas switches and junction boxes
Anchor bolt design (3/4" dia.) for lateral overturning resistance
